title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About the Role 
 You'll own the customer support and success function for our public-sector platforms leading a team of support associates while staying hands-on with customers yourself. You'll run day-to-day support operations across every channel, make sure issues are resolved within SLAs, handle the complex technical and non-technical escalations that reach you, and build strong, long-term relationships with stakeholders. You'll also coordinate with product, engineering, and operations teams to fix recurring problems at the root, and turn what the team learns into playbooks, SOPs, and process improvements. This role is ideal for someone who leads from the front, follows through relentlessly, and enjoys building both a team and a system that customers can rely on. 
 What You'll Do 
 Lead and mentor the team Guide support associates on prioritising tasks, managing tickets, and resolving customer issues within defined SLAs. Coach them on product knowledge, process, and professional customer communication so the team can resolve issues independently and consistently. Manage team performance — Set clear targets for the team and individuals, review workload and ticket allocation, track performance against resolution time, SLA compliance, and customer satisfaction, run regular reviews and huddles, give timely feedback, and identify and close capability gaps through training. Own support operations end to end — Oversee customer queries, tickets, and escalations across all channels — voice calls, emails, chats, WhatsApp, and in-person interactions — and ensure uninterrupted coverage by directly handling customer calls, tickets, and walk-in queries whenever required. Drive resolution and escalation management — Monitor ticket status and SLA adherence, proactively follow up with team members and internal stakeholders on pending issues, take corrective action on delays, and escalate unresolved or overdue issues to higher authorities until closure. Handle complex issues and senior stakeholders — Take on complex technical and non-technical queries, escalation calls, and sensitive customer concerns; Build strong, long-term relationships with government and public-sector stakeholders. Provide configuration assistance — Provide configuration assistance and product-related support to ensure smooth product usage and adoption. Coordinate across internal teams — Work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and other teams to resolve issues efficiently, represent the customer's priorities internally, and improve the overall support experience. Analyse metrics and improve the process — Track and analyse support metrics such as resolution time, SLA compliance, customer satisfaction, and engagement, identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities, and drive process changes that make support faster and more reliable. Document and report — Maintain accurate records of customer issues, escalations, follow-ups, and resolutions, prepare clear and professional customer communication including emails, status updates, and resolution notifications, report to internal and customer stakeholders on time, and create, maintain, and periodically update support playbooks, SOPs, and process documentation that standardise how the team works. 
 What We're Looking For 
 QUALITIES 
 Leadership and mentoring — You lead from the front, guide and develop a team, hold people to standards without micromanaging, and step in yourself whenever the customer needs it. Ownership and follow-through — You take end-to-end accountability for every ticket and commitment, chase pending items until they are closed, and never let an issue go cold. Communication and stakeholder management — You communicate clearly and professionally in writing, on calls, and in person, stay calm in escalations, and build trust with government stakeholders and senior officials. Problem-solving and prioritisation — You diagnose technical and non-technical issues quickly, judge what matters most, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Process and documentation mindset — You turn recurring problems into standard processes, and write documentation the team actually uses. Adaptability and learning mindset — You thrive in a startup environment, adapt quickly to changing priorities, embrace feedback, and are comfortable learning new tools and technologies. 
 MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS 
 Minimum 1 year of Customer Support or Customer Success experience in a team lead role . Excellent verbal and written English; fluency in Telugu and/or Hindi is mandatory . Must be a Graduate or Post Graduate from Top 100 NIRF colleges — as per the NIRF 2025 Engineering or Management Rankings. Ability to handle both technical and non-technical queries across multiple support channels. Proficiency in Google Sheets, PowerPoint, reporting tools, and general computer operations. 
 GOOD TO HAVE 
 Hands-on experience with ticketing systems, SLA tracking, and escalation management. Exposure to government or public-sector IT projects and stakeholder coordination. Familiarity with CRM and customer support platforms. Experience creating and maintaining SOPs, playbooks, and process documentation.

title: Customer support travel specialist
description:
Customer support travel specialist 
Our philosophy for customer service is simple: Listen to the customer. Understand their needs. Take ownership. Solve the problem. When a customer contacts Miraee, you take the responsibility till the need is addressed or the issue is solved. You will own urgent disruptions, complex multi-leg trips, VIP requests, and edge cases the AI agents couldn't resolve. Our customers include CEOs, CFOs, senior executives, executive assistants, and frequent business travelers with urgent and complex travel needs. 
 You will own four KPIs: First-Response Time (FRT) Resolution Time Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) Ownership Rate End-to-End Issue Resolution 
 What you will do Handle flight changes, cancellations, rebooking, delays, missed connections, and other travel disruptions especially last-minute and complex requests. Book domestic and international flights, hotels, car rentals, rail, airport transfers, and ground transportation when the frequent travelers are in need. Flag recurring pain points and agent failure patterns to Product and Engineering so the AI improves - you are a key input to our product feedback loop. Support travelers with check-in, seat and upgrade requests, and hotel needs such as early check-in and late checkout. Assist with restaurant bookings, private dinners, meetings, conferences, and other business travel needs. Understand the traveler's schedule and recommend the best available option. Work directly with airlines, hotels, and travel partners to resolve customer issues. Support customers across phone, chat, email, and messaging; keep them updated until the issue is fully resolved. Escalate account-level or program-level issues to the Enterprise Customer Success Manager; you own the traveler, they own the account. 
 Experience needed 3 - 5 years in corporate travel, business travel, airline ticketing, travel agency, or travel customer support. Hands-on experience with at least one GDS: Sabre, Amadeus, Apollo, Galileo, or Travelport. Experience handling US domestic and international travel. Experience supporting business travelers, senior executives, VIPs, or frequent travelers. Strong understanding of flight bookings, changes, cancellations, exchanges, refunds, and fare rules. Experience handling travel disruptions and last-minute changes. Prior experience at a corporate travel desk or travel management company preferred. 
 Skills we value Excellent spoken and written English. Strong attention to detail. Sound problem-solving and decision-making. Comfortable with demanding travelers with complex needs. Able to manage multiple customer requests simultaneously. Takes ownership instead of passing problems along. Comfortable with travel technology and quick to learn new systems including working alongside AI agents.
